title: Turn 1 Event Envelope (v1.0.0)
description: Common envelope for all simulator/ingestion events in turn 1, validated at the ingestion boundary. event_type selects the payload schema via oneOf. See ADR-0002.

schema_version.description: Message contract version (SemVer). Turn 1 accepts only 1.0.0. A breaking change requires a new major version; see ADR-0002.

event_id.description: Globally unique event identifier (UUID v4). Together with source it forms the idempotency key (source + event_id).

event_type.description: Discriminator that selects the payload schema.

source.description: Producing source identifier. Turn 1 source is 'simulator'.

event_ts.description: Event time, when the event occurred, in UTC (RFC 3339). Used in all calculations.

arrival_ts.description: Arrival time, stamped by ingestion when the message is received. Not sent by the source; optional in the inbound message and overwritten by ingestion.

payload.description: Event-specific payload. Its shape is constrained by event_type through oneOf.
